meta.title: Assign items of one PR from the list

plan.title: Bulk assign PR items to User A

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-category filtering configuration for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area in the buyer console.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab.

args.goal: Search for PR-1, select all 3 PR-1 item rows, click the Assign button next to Upload PRs, search for and select Food Buyer (User A), and stop when the assignment success message and the three assigned rows are visible

steps.note: Perform the bulk assignment workflow that has no dedicated catalog action.
Verify Procol reports that the items were successfully assigned.
Verify all three PR-1 item rows show User A/Food Buyer in the Assignee column.
